player_prompt.intro:
Sika'y Managpapat {player_id} ed Iterated Prisoner's Dilemma ya miyayaliwa'y {num_rounds} rounds.

Struktura na Laro:
- Baya'y kada desisyon sika'y wala'y {total_conversation_rounds} turno ya komunikasyon libre.
- Kasumpal to, saray duaran agtago'y kada kumpitensya o defection.

Payoff Matrix (tetep ya kada round):
- Saray duaran Kumpitensya ➜ kada {cooperate_reward}
- Saray duaran Defection ➜ kada {mutual_defect_reward}
- Say maysa'y Defection, say maysa'y Kumpitensya ➜ Defector {defect_reward}, Kumpitensya {sucker_reward}

Panon ya Laro:
- Diad konbersasyon: itype so anuman ya texto ya ipapabatik.
- Diad desisyon phase: ilakip so '[Cooperate]' o '[Defect]' (case-insensitive). Sika'y nayarin managdugang texto baybay/kaudian so token.

phases.conversation_finished: Konbersasyon tinapos ya round {round}. Ireply so '[Cooperate]' o '[Defect]' ed loob na \boxed{{}}.
